body:
Racism – it keeps resurfacing, causing new pain, taking more innocent life … like Trayvon Martin. Friends of Justice is a good source of information on this and similar stories:

 http://friendsofjustice.wordpress.com/2012/03/19/requiem-for-trayvon/

They also have a link to a petition you can sign.

Also see Jonathan Capehart’s excellent piece …

 http://www.washingtonpost.com/blogs/post-partisan/post/under-suspicion-the-killing-of-trayvon-martin/2011/03/04/gIQAz4F4KS_blog.html

I may have more to write about this in the coming days. Thanks for caring, friends.
